speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and its Departments work as one Home Team to keep Singapore safe and secure.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To fulfil our mission, we regularly update our laws, leverage technology extensively to enhance operational effectiveness, train and develop our officers for emerging challenges, and build partnerships with the public and international community.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Singapore remains one of the safest countries in the world.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To continue keeping Singapore safe and secure, we need to address significant and emerging threats.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: First, terrorism continues to be a pressing and real threat.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Second, criminal syndicates are making sophisticated use of technology to operate across national boundaries, resulting in notable increases in online scams and cybercrimes.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Third, psychoactive substances and more liberal attitudes internationally towards drug use pose challenges to our efforts to keep Singapore drug-free.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Furthermore, we must continue to safeguard Singapore’s social cohesion, in particular our racial and religious harmony, which has anchored our country’s peace and progress.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We have amended the Misuse of Drugs Act to introduce a new legislative framework for psychoactive substances.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Home Team will continue to leverage technology such as data analytics, robotics, and unmanned systems to increase operational effectiveness, reduce operational risks, and enable Home Team officers to focus on higher value tasks.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Immigration & Checkpoints Authority’s New Clearance Concept (NCC) automates passenger, conveyance, and cargo clearance.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In the near future, all residents, long-term pass holders, and departing visitors will be able to clear immigration without needing to present their passport.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: NCC will leverage data analytics and artificial intelligence to enhance detection of anomalies and security-sensitive items in conveyance and cargo clearance.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Singapore Police Force (SPF) is planning to expand camera coverage across Singapore and leverage video analytics to enhance sense-making.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Singapore Prison Service (SPS) is trialling a first-of-its-kind system – Prison Automated Screening System (PASS) – to automate urine sample collection and testing.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This improves efficiency and accuracy, and also requires fewer officers for supervision.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SPF and the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) are already deploying unmanned systems in various operational settings.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SPF uses robots to augment Police patrols and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) for crowd management and search operations.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SCDF has been enhancing its firefighting operations with its fleet of unmanned ground vehicles.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are also trialling UAVs which can be operated remotely from a central command and control centre.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This way, SPF and SCDF commanders can receive visuals of the scene even before officers arrive, allowing them to better plan their response.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Advancements in technology will change the way the Home Team operates.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To prepare our officers for evolving job roles, we will continue to invest heavily in their training, particularly in the area of digital technologies.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Home Team Academy will strengthen the Home Team’s training and learning ecosystem, such as by further developing and deploying systems for effective and realistic simulation training.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Home Team officers deal with stressful situations as part of their work.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to strengthen resilience and stress management, and foster a culture of support for the mental health and well-being of officers in the Home Team.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The spread of radical ideology online has fuelled the self-radicalisation threat in Singapore, especially for susceptible young individuals.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Public vigilance and preparedness through the SGSecure movement continues to be a key pillar of our defence.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to engage neighbourhoods, workplaces, and schools to sensitise, train and mobilise our community to play a part to prevent and deal with any terrorist attacks.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: A vigilant and discerning public is our best defence against scams.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MHA has launched a new national anti-scam campaign to encourage the public to act against scams.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will launch a Scam Public Education Office to drive and expand our outreach and communication efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Our networks of volunteers and advocates are critical to amplifying the Home Team’s effectiveness.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SCDF is enhancing the Community First Response framework through leveraging technology to improve response to cases via SCDF’s myResponder App, and will be installing fire extinguishers at HDB lift lobbies to equip the community to respond to minor fires.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SPF has rolled out the Community Watch Scheme, which seeks to build an informed and vigilant community.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will strengthen our bilateral relationships, and work constructively with and through multilateral organisations such as the International Criminal Police Organisation (INTERPOL), Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), and the United Nations.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: With the support of Singaporeans, the Home Team will strive to keep Singapore a safe and secure home for all.
